variables.telemetryQuery:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
| where _ResourceId =~ '__APPLICATION_INSIGHTS_RESOURCE_ID__'
| where Message == '__MESSAGE__'
| where tostring(Properties['probe.schema_version']) == '2.0'
| where tostring(Properties['probe.mode']) == 'live'
| where tostring(Properties['probe.service']) == '__SERVICE__'
| where tostring(Properties['probe.journey']) == '__JOURNEY__'
| where '__STEP__' == '' or tostring(Properties['probe.step']) == '__STEP__'
| where Message != 'synthetic-step' or tostring(Properties['probe.step_status']) in ('succeeded', 'failed')
| where Message == 'synthetic-step' or isnotnull(tobool(Properties['probe.success']))
| extend ObservedAt = todatetime(Properties['probe.observed_at'])
| where ObservedAt > ago(15m) and ObservedAt <= now()
| extend Success = iff(Message == 'synthetic-step',
    iff(tostring(Properties['probe.step_status']) == 'succeeded', 1.0, 0.0),
    iff(tobool(Properties['probe.success']), 1.0, 0.0)),
    Duration = todouble(Properties['probe.duration_ms'])
| where isnotnull(Duration) and Duration >= 0
| summarize Value = __AGGREGATION__
| where isnotnull(Value)
